decisions.reason: As an adjacent extension of the core construction range that has remained in the portfolio without adverse signals, it likely performs at or near aspiration and is worth retaining.
This articulated dumper fits the firm's established capabilities and customer base, so in a growing market it would usually be kept unless results clearly fell below aspiration levels.
The reported large order and longstanding popularity in rental indicate performance clearly above aspiration for this close-to-core product line, making withdrawal very unlikely.

Although more distant from the established offer, the very strong early operating result suggests promising market acceptance, so organisational slack and ongoing search would favor keeping it for further learning.
